title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 4: B1 FLUENCY & REAL-WORLD ENGLISH
description: A deeper B1 world focused on fluency, precision, natural communication, connected reading and listening, practical decisions, social English, study skills and independent production.

missions.title: B1 Vocabulary Lab — Precision Power
missions.focus: collocations, word families, phrasal verbs, synonyms, antonyms and context-dependent meaning

missions.title: Grammar Control — Tense Mastery
missions.focus: present, past and future forms in connected communication; choosing tense by meaning and context

missions.title: Present Perfect Deep Dive
missions.focus: for, since, already, yet, just, ever, never and unfinished time with real-life situations

missions.title: Narrative Mastery
missions.focus: past simple, past continuous and past perfect to build detailed stories and explain sequences

missions.title: Conditionals in Real Life
missions.focus: zero and first conditional review plus second conditional for advice, imagination and choices

missions.title: Modals for Meaning
missions.focus: must, have to, should, might, may, could and can for obligation, advice, possibility and permission

missions.title: Linking Ideas Like a B1 Speaker
missions.focus: although, however, therefore, while, unless, because, so, despite and in addition

missions.title: People, Identity & Social Life
missions.focus: personality, relationships, communication styles, feelings, conflict and respectful responses

missions.title: Technology, Media & Digital Life
missions.focus: devices, social media, online safety, information quality, digital habits and explaining technology

missions.title: B1 Fluency Lab — Ten Minutes
missions.focus: 10-minute guided-to-independent conversation with follow-up questions, clarification, examples and opinions

missions.title: Reading Mastery — The Unexpected Opportunity
missions.focus: 900–1050 word B1 text with gist, detail, inference, writer purpose, reference and vocabulary in context

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Voices in the Real World
missions.focus: 8–10 minute natural listening with interviews, announcements and informal conversation; identify attitude and key details

missions.title: Writing Lab — Email, Message & Opinion
missions.focus: formal and informal tone, paragraph structure, linking devices, requests, explanations and opinion writing

missions.title: Presentation Mission — Teach Me Something
missions.focus: prepare and deliver a 4–5 minute presentation with opening, sequence, examples, signposting and conclusion

missions.title: Travel & Accommodation Simulation
missions.focus: booking, check-in, directions, delays, changes, complaints, clarification and polite solutions

missions.title: Health, Safety & Emergency English
missions.focus: describing symptoms, asking for help, understanding instructions, giving essential information and staying calm

missions.title: Agree, Disagree & Negotiate
missions.focus: agreeing, partial agreement, polite disagreement, proposing alternatives and reaching a practical decision

missions.title: B1 Simulation — A Day Full of Problems
missions.focus: integrated real-world scenarios requiring listening, explanation, decisions, requests, negotiation and follow-up

missions.title: B1 Full Skills Marathon
missions.focus: high-density review across vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, reading, listening, speaking, writing and real-life English

missions.title: WORLD 4 MASTER QUEST — B1 FLUENCY
missions.focus: final integrated B1 challenge combining natural listening, advanced reading, extended speaking, practical communication, presentation and writing

content_targets.core_vocabulary: 1000+ active words, collocations, phrasal verbs and functional communication chunks
content_targets.reading: 900–1050 word B1 texts with inference and writer-purpose tasks
content_targets.listening: 8–10 minute natural multi-speaker listening with attitude and detail questions
content_targets.speaking: 10-minute sustained conversation plus a 4–5 minute presentation
content_targets.writing: 250–300 word structured writing across practical and opinion formats
content_targets.mastery: Learner communicates independently at B1 level across familiar real-world situations, connects ideas clearly, explains reasons, handles problems, understands natural spoken English and produces organized extended speech and writing.
